visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young woman with a grey headband lying on a treatment bed. A white electronic device with blue buttons is pressed against her cheek by a professional hand. White guide lines are marked on her face over a clear gel. The lighting is bright and sterile, typical of a clinic. (2) The scene transitions to a side-by-side comparison of the woman's face from two different dates (4/23 and 5/29). She is shown in a medium shot wearing a gold necklace in an indoor home setting with a wooden cabinet behind her. (3) A male doctor wearing a black mask and blue medical scrubs is shown in a medium shot operating the ultrasound device on a patient. He sits in a grey chair within a modern, well-lit medical office with shelves and equipment in the background. (4) An outdoor shot shows a woman in a pink hoodie walking toward the entrance of 'Lee's Beauty Clinic' on a city street with parked motorcycles and green trees. The building is grey with glass doors. (5) The camera focuses on a medical monitor displaying ultrasound scans, showing various layers of skin and muscle with technical text and diagrams. (6) The woman is seen in a selfie shot, looking into a mirror, touching her hair and smiling. She wears a beige hoodie and a gold necklace. (7) The final phase shows the woman and the male doctor standing together, smiling and flashing a peace sign toward the camera in a brightly lit clinic room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track begins with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM featuring a strong 4/4 beat. A female narrator speaks with a high-pitched, excited tone and fast speech rate, describing a cosmetic procedure. High-frequency digital UI 'blip' sounds are layered periodically to emphasize on-screen text. (2) As the narrator discusses the results, her voice maintains high arousal and positive valence. The BGM continues uninterrupted, providing a constant energetic energy. Small percussive sound effects like 'pops' trigger with subtitle changes. (3) A brief interaction occurs where a male voice is heard speaking in a lower, calm register, followed by the sound of light, friendly laughter between the two speakers. The background music remains prominent but ducks slightly under the dialogue. (4) The final phase concludes with the narrator's voice reaching a peak of enthusiasm, ending with a cheerful 'Thank you' and a rising intonation, while the music fades out quickly after a final drum hit.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for a cosmetic ultrasound lifting procedure (Ultherapy) at Lee's Beauty Clinic in Taichung. By showing the creator's personal before-and-after results, her mother's experience, and the professional yet friendly atmosphere of the clinic, the content aims to convince viewers of the treatment's effectiveness and comfort.
